title: Office furniture Newcastle: a Cardiff reception makeover
excerpt: Reception furniture for a Cardiff business, completed for Total Fitouts Newcastle. A welcoming arrival area forms the first stage of a wider furniture project for a growing team.
challenge: A Cardiff business needed its reception to work better for clients visiting the office. Your Office Space completed the reception furniture makeover for Total Fitouts Newcastle, bringing a reception desk and visitor seating into the space.
solution: The completed reception combines a timber-look reception counter, grey upholstered visitor chairs and a small round table. The furniture gives arriving clients a defined reception point and a place to sit while visiting the business.
outcome: The reception stage is complete. The wider project also includes electric height-adjustable desks and additional desks and workstations for the growing team.

sections.heading: The brief: a functional, welcoming reception
paragraphs: Reception furniture needs to support the working day as well as the first impression. For this Cardiff office, the brief was to make the space functional and welcoming for clients visiting the business.
The completed photographs show the reception counter and a coordinated visitor seating area. The business is unnamed in this case study; Total Fitouts Newcastle was the client for the furniture work.

sections.heading: Stage one: reception furniture in place
paragraphs: A Castle Deluxe reception desk, sourced from EOF, anchors the reception area. Its timber-look face is complemented by grey upholstered chairs, black chair frames and a small round table.

The counter provides a recognisable arrival point, while the separate seating gives visitors somewhere to wait or meet. This case study covers the furniture makeover, rather than attributing the room’s building finishes or other fitout work to YOS.
bullets: Reception desk to establish the front-of-office arrival point
Upholstered visitor seating for clients attending the office
A compact round table within the seating arrangement

sections.heading: Stage two: furniture for a growing team
paragraphs: The wider two-stage project also includes upgrading desks to electric height-adjustable models and adding desks and workstations as the team grows.
The photographs on this page document the completed reception stage. They do not show the desk and workstation upgrade, and this case study does not report that second stage as completed.

sections.heading: What to consider for your own Newcastle reception furniture
paragraphs: Use the completed project as a starting point for your brief, then check the actual requirements of your premises before choosing products.
bullets: Measure the room, doorways and delivery route before selecting a counter or chairs.
Record how many visitors typically arrive together and the tasks performed at reception.
Check circulation, access requirements and the space needed behind the counter with the appropriate project team.
Compare the counter, seating and table together, including finishes, dimensions, cleaning requirements and any storage or power needs.
Include delivery, assembly and installation as separate confirmed items in the quote.
For a staged upgrade, map the future desk and workstation layout before committing to the first order.

sections.heading: The completed reception
paragraphs: The reception makeover is complete, with furniture in place to create a functional and welcoming setting for clients. The supplied project photographs show the actual Cardiff reception.
The next furniture decisions form part of the wider team-growth brief: electric height-adjustable desks and additional workpoints, selected around the business’s requirements.
